newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 109.1 March 21 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 109.1 March 21 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) fell to 109.1 in the week ended March 21 from a revised 109.2 the prior week, ECRI said.
Both the growth rates of real estate loans and industrial material prices decreased, while the insured unemployment rate remained at an eight-year low of 2.0 percent, ECRI said.

"While underlying inflationary pressures have not increased over the past week, neither have they receded, and the advance in the FIG continues to be pervasive, reasonably pronounced and increasingly persistent," ECRI said.
